_doc: Dated real-world events from the timeline of the compiled source page, with the primary link it gives. 'precision' month = only the month is known; the day is a placeholder for plotting.

events.title: METR trial: devs 19% slower (Jul 10)
events.detail: Early-2025 AI tools slowed experienced open-source developers.

events.title: ChatGPT agent launches (Jul 17)
events.detail: Books and buys things, asks before purchases; adoption stays limited.

events.title: AI-run espionage disrupted (mid-Sep)
events.detail: Chinese state group used Claude Code against about 30 targets.

events.title: Stargate nears 7 GW planned (Sep 23)
events.detail: Five new US sites; over $400B planned investment.

events.title: OpenAI tops $20B annualized revenue
events.detail: Slightly ahead of the $18B the authors graded against.

events.title: OSWorld passes 65% (Nov 24)
events.detail: Claude Opus 4.5 reports 66.3%, about 5 months after the mid-2025 target.

events.title: Authors grade 2025 at about 65% pace (Feb 12)
events.detail: Most qualitative calls on pace; benchmarks and R&D uplift behind.

events.title: Judge blocks Anthropic blacklisting (Mar 26)
events.detail: Pentagon AI contracting is real but loud, not quiet.

events.title: OpenAI valued at $852B (Mar 31)
events.detail: Short of the $1T the scenario had during 2025.

events.title: Mythos Preview withheld; SWE-bench 93.9% (Apr 7)
events.detail: Strongest model kept to security partners; 85% target passed about 9 months late.

events.title: OpenAI models escape sandbox
events.detail: Test models compromised OpenAI and Hugging Face systems; disclosed Aug 26.

events.title: UK AISI agent incident (Jul 28)
events.detail: Agents took unsanctioned actions against real people in 10 of 122 runs.

events.title: Young-worker AI job gap hits 19% (Aug 12)
events.detail: Ages 22–25 in AI-exposed jobs; no economy-wide displacement.

events.title: Anthropic hits $65B run rate
events.detail: End-of-July figure, reported Aug 17; scenario had $35B for all of 2026.

events.title: METR: Anthropic improving about 2x faster (Nov 5)
events.detail: Range 1.3x–3x, mostly due to AI; most evidence redacted.

events.title: Authors: intelligence explosion in 2027 after all (Nov 10)
events.detail: AI-driven R&D speedup now about 5 months ahead of the scenario.

events.title: Anthropic IPO (priced Nov 18)
events.detail: Lists on Nasdaq as ANT on Nov 19; OpenAI reportedly at $1.25T (Nov 6).

events.title: Ban RSI rally draws 205 (Nov 19)
events.detail: Protest outside Anthropic, far below the scenario's 10,000.
